in_marathi.name: Jahnvika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jahnvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jahnvika is a Sanskrit name derived from 'Jah' (victory) and 'Nika' (goddess). It signifies the goddess of victory, triumph, and success. In Hindu mythology, Jahnvika represents the divine feminine power that bestows strength, courage, and wisdom upon its bearer.
